clinical_notes: a 61 year old woman presented with pneumonia and respiratory failure. she was intubated and ventilated due to worsening dyspnea. chest x-ray after nasogastric tube insertion showed tube projecting over the anatomical area of the right main and right lower lobe bronchi. multiple attempts of nasogastric tube insertion showed similar findings (fig1). ct revealed diagnosis. chest x ray ap view. nasogastric tube seen in the radiolucent area of trachea and right main bronchus
